{{Top|leg}}
[[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] maintained a '''Technical Branch Outpost''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lotide]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The base was located several hundred [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from [[Market City]] in the middle of a large [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]]. It was [[Mission to Lotide|infiltrated]] by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents who used the information gleaned in the raid to capture the ''[[Black Ice/Legends|Black Ice]]''.
